To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the student union is perceived as a major player in the administration of the university and that it should be involved in all areas of administration, with the possible exception of the appointment of staff and the award of scholarships and bursaries.

the majority of the respondents (i.e., students and parents) believed that the student union was not involved in the administration of the university.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of students in the administration of tertiary institutions.
the role of student unions in university governance.
the role and involvement of students in the administration of their institutions of higher learning.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the respondents perceived that there should be a greater involvement of the student union in the administration of tertiary institutions.

the respondents were of the opinion that the student union in institutions of higher learning should be involved in the administration of such institutions, but the extent of such participation should be regulated.

the students and the staff of the institutions of higher learning are not satisfied with the level of participation of the students in the administration of their institutions, and they are not satisfied with their involvement in decision making.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the study found that there are areas where the student union should be involved in the administration of the institutions of higher learning.

we are not only concerned with the issue of the student union involvement in the administration of the university, but we are also concerned about the issue of the involvement of all the stakeholders in the administration of tertiary institutions in Nigeria.
the student union is a very important part of the administration in tertiary institutions.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the student union has a significant role in tertiary institutions, especially in the areas of welfare and discipline of students, and that there is no need to restrict the union's participation to these areas.
the student union is a vital part of the governance structure of higher education institutions, and its participation in institutional governance is essential for the success of the institution.
the student union can play a significant role in the administration of the institutions of higher learning.
